steps.text: The atom has a small positive nucleus surrounded by electrons; nucleons are protons and neutrons.
Quarks build hadrons: proton = uud, neutron = udd; leptons include electrons and neutrinos.
β⁻ decay: n → p + e⁻ + antineutrino; β⁺ decay: p → n + e⁺ + neutrino.
Every interaction conserves charge, baryon number and lepton number.
Strangeness is conserved in strong interactions but not in weak interactions.
Antiparticles have opposite charge, baryon and lepton numbers.
